deep_dive.title: Sakae Electronics: can the small-cap semiconductor catch-up trade hold near limit-up into the afternoon

lines: Sakae Electronics is a leading candidate for the spread of semiconductor buying from major leaders into lagging small caps.
The market is focusing on a 2.2x prior-year operating-profit increase, a projected 27% ordinary-profit increase, a dividend hike outlook and a low-0.6x PBR.
The broader market weakened after the open on May 26, but Sakae Electronics still briefly reached limit-up.
Orders from semiconductor-equipment makers are expected to keep improving, helped by generative-AI-related demand.
Can it hold the 620-yen area and re-test the 649-yen limit-up level.
Does the volume surge persist as part of a broader catch-up move in semiconductor-adjacent names.
A drop below 600 yen would suggest the limit-up attempt was mainly a one-shot price spike.
Semiconductor money rotates back to major leaders and Kioxia-linked names, leaving small-cap laggards behind.
Liquidity is limited and short-term money can rotate out quickly.
If oil rises again or Middle East headlines hit the index, even strong catalyst names can face cash-raising selling.
